remarks: AVAILABLE JUNE-LABOR DAY for a minimum two month lease. JULY-LABOR DAY for a one month minimum lease. Beautiful summer House with pool: Just one hour from NYC and two miles from the charming small town of New Canaan, buzzing with boutique shops and outdoor restaurants, this elegant, private family retreat sits on two quiet manicured acres. Perfect for relaxing poolside, swinging in a hammock, gathering by the firepit in Adirondack chairs or dining on a string-lit stone patio. The neighborhood is ideal for biking and walking, with plenty of young families. This spacious, fully-equipped home features 5 bedrooms and 4.5 baths, comfortably sleeping 8.   Gourmet eat-in kitchen with pool view, living room, family room, large office area with views of the backyard and pool. Main floor bedroom has a king bed (or two twins) and ensuite bathroom. This room can convert to a second office with the twin beds moved down to the finished basement for extra guests.  The second floor offers a primary suite with king bed, ensuite bathroom with shower and soaking tub. Three more bedrooms (one queen, two full) share two generous hall bathrooms.  Other amenities include: Game room with pool table, large laundry room, wi-fi extending out to the pool, grill and Traeger wood-pellet smoker.
